bull_case: A broad cybersecurity platform spanning network, SASE, cloud, SOC and identity can support multiple growth vectors and a Bull value near $460.
bear_case: At the current price, Bear value is only ~22% of market price and Base is well below market, so downside asymmetry is unfavorable if growth normalizes.
thesis: Business quality is high but investment asymmetry is not. Bull/current is only about 1.27x while Bear/current is about 0.22x. Strong net cash and recurring revenue reduce existential risk, yet the current valuation makes ordinary execution disappointment economically costly.

evidence.claim: Bull/current is ~1.265 and Bear/current ~0.222 using the locked DCF.
FY2026 NGS ARR reached $9.10B and RPO $21.2B.

counterevidence: Cybersecurity consolidation and AI security demand could support a higher-than-normal long-term multiple.
unknowns: Probability that FY30 NGS ARR target is met without margin dilution
falsifiers: A materially lower share price without deterioration would improve asymmetry.
Owner FCF/share consistently above Bull path would raise upside-path score.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Valuation is decision-critical and requires later RT review if the pipeline proceeds.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: PANW has substantial liquid net cash and strong operating cash flow; bankruptcy/permanent-capital impairment is not the dominant downside.

next_checks: Reassess after price or FCF path changes

subscores.rationale: Bull/current ~1.27x with multiple business growth vectors; observable anchor supports 60.
Scenario analysis explicitly separates strong business quality from valuation downside.

uncertainties.rationale: Acquisition synergies could widen upside but are not yet proven.
Bear valuation implies severe mark-to-market downside without insolvency.
Cybersecurity secular growth can support unusually long growth duration.
